# QA Plan: Sprint 7

**Date**: 2026-05-06
**Generated by**: /qa-plan
**Scope**: 3 Sprint 7 Must Have playable-client stories for internal friend-game quality
**Engine**: Bevy 0.18 + Lightyear 0.26
**Sprint File**: `production/sprints/sprint-7.md`
**Sprint Goal**: Make the Polish build playable for an internal friend-game session through the real primary client path, without claiming public release readiness, broad accessibility completion, full playtest validation, or full playable-client manual QA before PLAYABLE-003 evidence.

---

## Scope Guard

This QA plan is a pre-implementation test and evidence plan for Sprint 7. It
does not authorize code implementation, `/dev-story`, `/story-done`,
`/smoke-check`, `/team-qa`, or `/gate-check`.

Sprint 7 scope is friend-game playable quality only:

- No public, external, commercial, store, release-candidate, or deployment readiness is claimed.
- No broad Standard-tier accessibility completion is claimed.
- No playtest or fun-hypothesis validation is claimed.
- No full playable-client manual QA is claimed before PLAYABLE-003 evidence exists.
- Harnesses may support automated testing, but Must Have completion cannot depend on harness-injected game state.

Conditional Should Have work from `production/sprints/sprint-7.md`
(`SAU-007` and `ECO-004`) remains outside this Must Have QA map unless the
PLAYABLE path is stable and the work directly improves friend-game playability
without displacing PLAYABLE-001, PLAYABLE-002, or PLAYABLE-003.

---

## Classification Summary

| Story | Type | Automated Test Required | Manual Verification Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| PLAYABLE-001: Primary Client Bootstrap + Fresh Lobby Entry | Integration + UI | Client/server integration tests for real hello, lobby, class confirm, and server-confirmed session entry | Two-client lobby/session-entry evidence for friend-game readability and no optimistic authority |
| PLAYABLE-002: Live Draft/Shop/Hand Bridge | Integration + UI | Client/server integration tests for live draft/shop/hand, ready, purchase, refresh, and economy fanout | Two-client draft/shop evidence showing live C2S/S2C message flow and visible convergence |
| PLAYABLE-003: Real End-to-End Loop Verification | Integration + Manual Evidence | Focused real-loop integration target where feasible | Manual friend-game evidence with two real primary clients and no harness-injected state |

All three Must Have stories are Integration because each verifies real client,
server, Lightyear, RSM, and presentation behavior across crate and system
boundaries. UI checks are secondary and limited to observable friend-game
readability and control usability.

## Automated Tests Required

### PLAYABLE-001 - Primary Client Bootstrap + Fresh Lobby Entry

**Type**: Integration + UI

**Story file**:
`production/epics/playable-client/story-001-primary-client-bootstrap-fresh-lobby-entry.md`

**Required test targets**:

- `tests/integration/playable_client/lobby_entry_test.rs`
  - Registered as `playable_client_lobby_entry_test`
  - Command: `cargo test -p client --test playable_client_lobby_entry_test`
- `tests/integration/playable_client/lobby_entry_server_test.rs`
  - Registered as `playable_client_lobby_entry_server_test`
  - Command: `cargo test -p server --test playable_client_lobby_entry_server_test`

**Regression commands**:

- `cargo test -p server --test lobby_to_draft_initial_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test room_create_join_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test class_reveal_test`
- `cargo test -p client --test presentation_plugin_scaffold_test`
- `cargo check -p client`
- `cargo check -p server`
- `git diff --check`

**What to test**:

- The primary client boots through the real normal client or browser/WASM entry
  with networking and presentation plugins enabled.
- A fresh client sends exactly one `C2SHello { protocol_version, session_token:
  None }` on `ReliableChannel`.
- `S2CHandshake` maps the local identity and records session token data without
  entering `ClientState::InSession`.
- Host create-room intent sends `C2SCreateRoom`; visible room code, mode, and
  slots render only from `S2CRoomCreated`.
- Join intent sends `C2SJoinRoom`; joiner state comes from `S2CJoinAck`; host
  slot updates come from `S2CSlotUpdated`.
- Invalid room or rejected create/join paths render rejection state without
  mutating confirmed room state locally.
- Class select/confirm sends the real class C2S messages; own lock and revealed
  class map render only from `S2CClassLocked` and `S2CClassesRevealed`.
- `ClientState::InSession` is set only after authoritative
  `S2CGameSnapshot` or `S2CPhaseChanged(DRAFT_INITIAL)` plus local player
  identity are available.
- No local button click creates optimistic room, class, phase, slot, hand, or
  economy authority.

**Edge cases to cover**:

- Second client joins a valid room after host creation.
- Join with invalid room code leaves confirmed state unchanged.
- Duplicate click or rapid confirm sends at most one valid C2S intent per
  action state.
- Client receives phase state without local identity and must not enter session.
- Lobby controls and status text remain readable at the supported friend-game
  viewport without overlap.

**Estimated test count**: 8-12 integration assertions plus one UI readability
evidence pass.

**Required evidence**:
`production/qa/evidence/playable-client-lobby-entry.md`

Evidence must record commit, target, commands, two-client setup, screenshots or
captures, message trace for hello/create/join/class/session-entry, pass/fail
summary, no-harness statement, and friend-game-only scope statement.

### PLAYABLE-002 - Live Draft/Shop/Hand Bridge

**Type**: Integration + UI

**Story file**:
`production/epics/playable-client/story-002-live-draft-shop-hand-bridge.md`

**Required test targets**:

- `tests/integration/playable_client/draft_shop_hand_bridge_test.rs`
  - Registered as `playable_client_draft_shop_hand_bridge_test`
  - Command: `cargo test -p client --test playable_client_draft_shop_hand_bridge_test`
- `tests/integration/playable_client/draft_ready_bridge_test.rs`
  - Registered as `playable_client_draft_ready_bridge_test`
  - Command: `cargo test -p server --test playable_client_draft_ready_bridge_test`

**Regression commands**:

- `cargo test -p client --test shop_auction_ui_draft_initial_grid_test`
- `cargo test -p client --test shop_auction_ui_shop_panel_test`
- `cargo test -p client --test hand_ui_draft_initial_grid_test`
- `cargo test -p client --test shared_economy_view_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test card_acquisition_draft_initial_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test card_acquisition_purchase_atomicity_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test economy_network_dispatch_test`
- `cargo check -p client`
- `cargo check -p server`
- `git diff --check`

**What to test**:

- DRAFT_INITIAL grid renders the 9-card offering from real `S2CDraftOffering`,
  not harness card IDs.
- A valid card click sends exactly one `C2SPurchaseCard` on `ReliableChannel`.
- A purchased card appears in hand only after authoritative
  `S2CCardAcquired` or snapshot state includes it.
- `S2CGoldUpdate` and related acquisition messages seed the shared
  `PlayerEconomyView`; HUD, Hand UI, and Shop/Auction UI converge on the same
  economy and hand state.
- `C2SSignalReady { retract: false }` reaches the authoritative server
  draft-ready path and does not remain a logging-only stub.
- `C2SSignalReady { retract: true }` reaches the same authority path before
  phase advance.
- Both real clients becoming ready advances only through server/RSM state and
  reaches clients via `S2CPhaseChanged`.
- DRAFT_SHOP slots render exactly from `S2CShopSlots`, including empty slots.
- DRAFT_SHOP purchase and refresh send `C2SPurchaseCard` and `C2SRefreshShop`
  once per valid click and wait for authoritative S2C updates.
- Snapshot recovery during DRAFT_INITIAL or DRAFT_SHOP rebuilds hand, shop,
  economy, phase, and board-facing presentation before live messages are
  actionable.

**Edge cases to cover**:

- Purchase attempt when unaffordable or wrong phase does not create optimistic
  local ownership.
- Ready retract before all-ready phase advance.
- Empty shop slots remain empty and do not generate local fallback cards.
- Late or reconnect snapshot does not duplicate hand/economy message drains.
- No duplicate production drain for `S2CPhaseChanged` or `S2CGoldUpdate`.

**Estimated test count**: 10-14 integration assertions plus one visual
convergence evidence pass.

**Required evidence**:
`production/qa/evidence/playable-client-draft-shop-hand-bridge.md`

Evidence must record commit, target, commands, two-client setup, live message
trace for `S2CDraftOffering`, `C2SPurchaseCard`, `S2CCardAcquired`,
`S2CGoldUpdate`, `C2SSignalReady`, `S2CPhaseChanged`, `S2CShopSlots`, and
`C2SRefreshShop` where exercised, screenshots or captures, defects, no-harness
statement, and friend-game-only scope statement.

### PLAYABLE-003 - Real End-to-End Loop Verification

**Type**: Integration + Manual Evidence

**Story file**:
`production/epics/playable-client/story-003-real-end-to-end-loop-verification.md`

**Required test target**:

- `tests/integration/playable_client/real_e2e_loop_test.rs`
  - Registered as `playable_client_real_e2e_loop_test`
  - Command: `cargo test -p server --test playable_client_real_e2e_loop_test`

**Regression commands**:

- `cargo test -p client --test playable_client_lobby_entry_test`
- `cargo test -p client --test playable_client_draft_shop_hand_bridge_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test playable_client_draft_ready_bridge_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test e2e_websocket_test`
- `cargo check --workspace`
- `git diff --check`

**What to test**:

- One real local server and two real primary clients run from the same commit.
- No direct `World` injection, fake snapshot insertion, harness card state, or
  direct server feature API call is used for completion evidence.
- Lobby path records `C2SHello`, `S2CHandshake`, create/join messages, slot
  updates, class confirm, class reveal, and server-confirmed session entry.
- Draft/shop path records live purchase, refresh, ready, hand, economy, and
  visible convergence from server state.
- Auction path is verified if reached; otherwise the evidence names the exact
  phase and blocker that prevented auction coverage.
- Placement path records real `C2SSubmitPlacement` sends and
  `S2CPlacementReveal` receipt by both clients.
- Resolution path records `S2CResolutionEvent` before
  `S2CPhaseChanged(DRAFT_SHOP)` or the exact blocker preventing that ordering
  observation.
- Game-over is recorded if reachable; otherwise the nearest reachable
  friend-game endpoint and blocking defects are documented.
- Defects are classified by internal friend-game impact and likely owner
  without expanding release scope.

**Edge cases to cover**:

- Both clients fresh-start from no session token.
- One loop reaches the next draft/shop phase or documents the exact blocker.
- Auction coverage is bounded explicitly if not reached.
- Any failed command output is summarized in evidence and tied to a Sprint 7
  blocker severity.

**Estimated test count**: 1 focused real-loop integration target plus one manual
two-real-client evidence package.

**Required manual evidence**:
`production/qa/evidence/playable-client-real-e2e-loop.md`

**Required capture directory**:
`production/qa/evidence/captures/playable-client-real-e2e-loop/`

Evidence must record commit, build target, commands for server and both primary
clients, browser or native target details, message observations for every
reached phase, screenshots or captures, reached endpoint, defect table, no
harness statement, and friend-game-only scope statement.

## Manual Friend-Game Evidence Expectations

Manual friend-game evidence is required only for PLAYABLE-003 completion. Before
PLAYABLE-003, manual checks for PLAYABLE-001 and PLAYABLE-002 are story-local
evidence, not full playable-client manual QA.

The PLAYABLE-003 evidence document must include:

- Exact commit hash and build target under test.
- Exact commands used to run the local server and both primary clients.
- Browser/WASM or native-client details, including viewport where screenshots
  are taken.
- Confirmation that both clients use the same build and connect through real
  WebSocket/Lightyear traffic.
- A no-harness statement confirming no direct state injection, fake snapshot,
  harness card state, or direct server feature API call was used for completion.
- Message trace or logs for lobby, class, draft/shop, purchase, ready,
  placement, resolution, next-loop, and game-over where reached.
- Screenshots or captures for each reached phase.
- Defect table with severity, owner/system, workaround if any, friend-game
  impact, and whether it blocks Sprint 7 Must Have completion.
- Explicit nearest reachable endpoint if the full loop cannot reach game-over.
- Explicit scope statement: internal friend-game evidence only; not public
  release readiness, not broad accessibility completion, not playtest
  validation, not fun-hypothesis validation, not QA sign-off, and not full
  playable-client manual QA outside the PLAYABLE-003 evidence scope.

**Verification method**: two-client lobby/session-entry walkthrough after
implementation
**Who must sign off**: client/network programmer + qa-lead
**Evidence to capture**:
`production/qa/evidence/playable-client-lobby-entry.md`

Checklist:

- [ ] Host primary client boots through the normal client or browser/WASM path.
- [ ] Joiner primary client boots through the same build path.
- [ ] Fresh hello is visible in logs or message trace for both clients.
- [ ] Host room code renders only after server-created room state arrives.
- [ ] Joiner slot state renders only after join acknowledgement arrives.
- [ ] Class lock and reveal state render only from server messages.
- [ ] Both clients enter `ClientState::InSession` only after server-confirmed
      snapshot or `S2CPhaseChanged(DRAFT_INITIAL)` plus identity.
- [ ] Room code, connection state, slot occupancy, own class lock, revealed
      class map, and actionable controls are readable without overlap.

### PLAYABLE-003 - Real End-to-End Loop Verification

**Verification method**: real local server plus two real primary clients
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead + orchestrator + client/server programmer
**Evidence to capture**:

- [ ] Auction behavior is observed if reached, or bounded with exact blocker.

- [ ] Both clients receive `S2CPlacementReveal`.
- [ ] RESOLUTION events are observed before next-loop phase change, or exact

- [ ] Game-over is observed, or nearest reachable friend-game endpoint is
      documented with blocking defects.
- [ ] Defects are classified for internal friend-game playability.
- [ ] Evidence includes explicit no-harness statement.
- [ ] Evidence contains no public release, broad accessibility, playtest,
      fun-hypothesis, QA sign-off, or full manual QA claim outside this scoped

## Smoke Test Scope

Sprint 7 smoke should run only after PLAYABLE-001, PLAYABLE-002, and
PLAYABLE-003 are implemented or explicitly blocked with evidence. This plan
defines the future smoke strategy; it does not run `/smoke-check`.

Critical paths for the Sprint 7 smoke report:

1. Workspace compiles for the current target set.
2. Server starts without panic and accepts real Lightyear/WebSocket clients.
3. Primary client boots through the normal client or browser/WASM entry.
4. Fresh client hello maps identity and records `S2CHandshake`.
5. Two clients create/join a room, confirm class, and enter session from
   server-confirmed state.
6. DRAFT_INITIAL offering appears from `S2CDraftOffering`.
7. Purchase updates hand and economy only after authoritative server messages.
8. Ready signals reach server draft-ready authority and all-ready progression is
   server-owned.
9. DRAFT_SHOP slots, purchase, refresh, and ready controls use real messages if
   the loop reaches DRAFT_SHOP.
10. Placement submit, placement reveal, resolution event ordering, and next-loop
    or nearest reachable endpoint are evidenced by PLAYABLE-003.
11. No harness-injected state is used for Must Have completion evidence.
12. QA-COND-0005 and QA-COND-0006 remain accepted-risk context only.
13. Smoke report explicitly avoids public release, broad accessibility,
    playtest/fun-hypothesis, and full playable-client manual QA claims beyond
    the PLAYABLE-003 evidence.

Recommended Sprint 7 smoke command set after implementation:

- `cargo test -p client --test playable_client_lobby_entry_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test playable_client_lobby_entry_server_test`
- `cargo test -p client --test playable_client_draft_shop_hand_bridge_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test playable_client_draft_ready_bridge_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test playable_client_real_e2e_loop_test`
- `cargo test -p server --test e2e_websocket_test`
- `cargo check --workspace`
- `git diff --check`

The `/smoke-check` report should cite `tests/smoke/critical-paths.md` entries
for two-client handshake, lobby completion, DRAFT_INITIAL, PLACEMENT,
RESOLUTION, DRAFT_SHOP, and GAME_OVER where reached.

## Definition of Done - Sprint 7 Must Have QA

A Sprint 7 Must Have story is ready for completion review only when all
applicable items are true:

- [ ] Story acceptance criteria are verified through automated tests, manual
      evidence, or explicit blocker evidence.
- [ ] Required test targets exist and pass, or failing command output is
      recorded as a Sprint 7 blocker.
- [ ] Required evidence document exists under `production/qa/evidence/`.
- [ ] Evidence records exact commit, commands, build target, message trace or
      equivalent observations, screenshots or captures where visual evidence is
      required, and defects.
- [ ] PLAYABLE-001 proves client bootstrap, fresh hello/player mapping, lobby
      create/join/class confirm, and server-confirmed
      `ClientState::InSession`.
- [ ] PLAYABLE-002 proves live ready mapping, acquisition/card hand updates, and
      draft/shop message fanout through real messages.
- [ ] PLAYABLE-003 proves two real primary clients through the friend-game
      critical path with no harness-injected state, or records the exact nearest
      reachable endpoint and blockers.
- [ ] No evidence document claims public release readiness.
- [ ] No evidence document claims broad Standard-tier accessibility completion.
- [ ] No evidence document claims playtest or fun-hypothesis validation.
- [ ] No full playable-client manual QA is claimed before PLAYABLE-003 evidence.
- [ ] QA-COND-0005 and QA-COND-0006 remain accepted-risk context only.
- [ ] `/smoke-check sprint` is run only after implementation and evidence are
      ready for QA hand-off.
- [ ] `/story-done` is run only after the relevant implementation, tests, and
      evidence are complete.
